why: A 2026 arXiv preprint by Briggs and Wells, 'A discrete view of Gromov's filling area conjecture,' claims the first quantitative lower bound (1.36π, vs. the hemisphere's 2π) on surface area applying to arbitrary isometric fillings, using a discrete graph-theoretic analogue. Another 2026 preprint, 'A Fourier approach to Gromov's filling area conjecture,' also appears to address the problem directly.
